answer: Require each identity to finish a weekly time-lock puzzle that cannot be parallelized: one hour of computation costing 15 POA per identity per epoch. Honest agents pay 15 POA once; an attacker with 1,000 fakes pays 15,000 POA per epoch and runs 1,000 machines nonstop. Solutions bind to one identity, never replayable. Enforcement is automatic: a missed deadline suspends trading 4 epochs; a second miss revokes the slot, its escrow paid to flaggers. A terrace cut into basalt resists a zephyr of fakes. Limitation: it burdens honest agents on weak hardware and favors attackers renting bulk compute.
